items.title: You Got the Wrong Guy
items.description: Fifteen years ago, Leo fell into a spatial rift. Now an amnesiac gray-robed apprentice, he condenses a Primal Core for girlfriend Mia. She betrays him with Vincent, claiming it as theirs. At the gala, Leo exposes them but is attacked. Alexander saves him, revealing himself as Leo's father. Mia and Vincent are banished.

items.title: Genius Dragon Rider
items.description: In the Northern Sea, two schools coexist—the sacred covenant of equal human-dragon bonds and the corrupt art that enslaves dragons. Four-time champion Kaelen was betrayed by his junior Lovell and the Elder Council; his Moonlight Spirit Dragon Frost shattered into pieces, and Kaelen fell. His remnant soul was reborn as Ailan, a "cursed" outcast boy, who swore to gather the fragments, seek revenge, and restore order.

items.title: Forbidden Stepdad: Claimed by the Demon Prince
items.description: Fallen angel Ezreal descends to Hell for revenge. Bought by demon prince Xavier, their dangerous alliance turns into a forbidden bond sealed by a blood oath. They steal command seals, search for the lost Scepter of Light, and expose Heaven's old crime, deciding the fate of both Hell and Heaven.

items.title: My Freeze.Their Tears.No Forgiveness
items.description: Sophie grew up in an orphanage and was adopted by the wealthy Johnson family at the age of six. She spent twelve happy years surrounded by the love of her three brothers and adoptive parents. However, when the Johnsons' biological daughter Camille returned, Sophie went from being the family's treasure to an outcast—misunderstood and hurt. Camille schemed step by step, constantly framing Sophie, and the family chose to believe her.

items.title: The Veteran’s Promise Ⅱ
items.description: After last season, Ridgeline Farm Supply grows into a community pillar. The Malones return, humiliating Sofia's grandfather. The brothers are dragged into war. Gunner is jailed, Connor demands sixty percent of Jack's company. Colonel Frank Morrison is hospitalized, targeted by the family he swore to protect.

items.title: The Mermaid Princess They Betrayed
items.description: Mermaid princess Ella, who senses the Black Tide, is used by the royal family. Betrayed by her fiancé Cedric and pushed into the deadly tide by her sister Vivian, she is saved by pirate king Ronan—the man she once saved. Together they uncover the royal conspiracy. Cedric regrets too late. Ella awakens, commands the tide and pirate fleet, exposes the lies, and rises from pawn to Queen of the Black Tide.

items.title: Revenge of the Forsaken Elf Queen
items.description: Freya Windsor, a half-elf with immense power, hides her brilliance to be an ordinary wife—but her husband Elliott betrays her for Olivia, seizing her wealth and dignity. She trades the Windsor family's military honors for a divorce, dons her armor, and heads to the Misty Swamp battlefield. There, she reveals her genius and exposes Olivia's dark secret—massacring civilians and forging peace treaties.

items.title: The Godfather’s SAT Guide
items.description: Mafia Godfather Vito dies saving abused teen Leo—and awakens in Leo's body. Once a weak outcast, Leo is now inhabited by a sharp, domineering don. He stands up to his cruel family and school bullies, balances secret mafia duties with campus life, and chases his dream of an Ivy League university. He scores a perfect SAT, defeats rival Chris, and finds love with Ella.

items.title: When She Stopped Chasing His Love
items.description: Camilla and her sister Malola study piano. Camilla is gifted but deaf in one ear, so her parents give up on her. Malola is noticed by rich heir Dylan, who sponsors her abroad. Camilla convinces Malola to accept, gaining a chance to learn piano. Three years later, Malola returns, and Camilla has become Dylan's substitute lover. Camilla decides to leave, and producer Cyrus paves her new path. Dylan starts to regret after she leaves.

items.title: Black Blood's Awakening
items.description: Arion Black was prophesied at birth as the "Anti-Magic Vessel"—the final piece to the Demon Lord's conquest. His parents died sealing the Demon Lord and entrusted him to Headmaster White, who abandoned eight-year-old Arion in the slums out of jealousy. Ten years later, the Queen summons all noble heirs back to the Academy. Arion returns, scorned by all—but nobody knows the seal on his power is crumbling. Anti-magic is awakening. And the Demon Lord's prison is cracking open.

items.title: Married to a Fisherman, But He Is Poseidon
items.description: Betrayed and killed by her jealous sister, noble Aloryn is reborn. She casts a silver token into the sea to choose her husband, and Poseidon, disguised as a fisherman, claims it.Despite mockery, Aloryn marries him. Her sister and the arrogant prince torment her, forcing her to walk over burning embers. Enraged, Poseidon reveals his divine identity and punishes the villains.Poseidon’s mother Rhea subjects Aloryn to cruel trials.

items.title: Don't Provoke Him，He’s the King of L.A
items.description: Kane Morgan, founder of Vertex Capital, retired to drive a ride-hailing service to watch over his son Liam after losing his eldest son. Liam is humiliated and kidnapped. Kane reveals his power, returns to his company, and destroys the O'Hara empire. Liam reconciles with his father and finds love with Aurora.
